document.title: KickStream Frontend UI/UX and Design Specification
document.scope: Public marketing funnel, authentication experience, guest contact affordances, chat widget UX, and admin entry surface.

experienceGoals.brandIntent: Convey premium, high-energy football streaming with editorial boldness, focused clarity, and modern confidence.
userGoals: Understand the KickStream value proposition immediately
Move from discovery to login/contact with minimal friction
See real-time match context and live engagement signals
Use guest support and WhatsApp contact without creating friction
Access chat and account context quickly after authentication
uxPrinciples: High visual contrast with a restrained yet athletic palette
Strong typography hierarchy for instant scanning on desktop and mobile
Progressive disclosure to keep marketing and support actions distinct
Fast visual feedback for async actions and socket state changes
Mobile-first touch ergonomics for key conversion and chat controls

usageRules: Use cream/off-white backgrounds for content-heavy sections
Use near-black for primary readability and framing
Reserve orange for kinetic highlights, emphasis, and progress
Reserve green for positive action states (send, WhatsApp, connected states)

display.role: Hero headlines, section headers, compact loud labels

hierarchyPattern: Uppercase micro-labels with letter spacing for section framing
Readable body copy with medium contrast

shapeAndDepth.borders: Frequent 2px hard borders to maintain editorial mechanical framing
shapeAndDepth.radius: Mostly square/low radius except chat/action pills
shapeAndDepth.shadows: Offset editorial shadows and soft functional shadows
shapeAndDepth.texture: Subtle texture overlay + gradient vignettes for atmosphere

motionLanguage.entry: Staggered word reveal and delayed content fade
motionLanguage.feedback: Button hover shifts, subtle pulse on key floating actions
motionLanguage.timing: Short and decisive for controls, slower for hero drama

behavior: Desktop horizontal links with primary CTA
nav.uxIntent: Keep focus on hero at top, then reveal navigation when user is ready to explore deeper.
nav.mobileNotes: Menu uses large touch targets and clear typographic hierarchy.

hero.content: Statement headline, kickoff timing line, primary CTA, and live-match framing.

mediaStrategy.desktop: Autoplay looping background video with poster fallback and progressive loading
mediaStrategy.mobile: Autoplay looping mobile-optimized video with muted inline playback protections

hero.uxIntent: Deliver emotional impact in the first viewport while preserving text legibility and fast entry for mobile users.
riskAndMitigation: Large media payload risk mitigated through poster fallback and optimization pipeline
Autoplay restrictions mitigated by muted+inline+retry strategy
Hero content remains readable when video is paused or blocked

pricing.design: Card-based plan comparison with highlighted popular option.
pricing.interaction: Primary CTA drives purchase intent and contact action.
pricing.uxIntent: Reduce cognitive load in plan comparison using consistent card rhythm and visual emphasis.

authPage.design: Split-brand experience on large screens, focused single-column form on mobile.
authPage.uxIntent: Prevent accidental privilege confusion and communicate role boundaries before submission.

chatWidget.placement: Bottom-right floating launcher with unread badge.
chatWidget.panel: Responsive fixed overlay with capped viewport height and safe-area spacing.
chatWidget.uxIntent: Preserve persistent support access without hijacking primary browsing tasks.

whatsappContactButton.behavior: Opens WhatsApp deep-link with prefilled message
whatsappContactButton.uxIntent: Offer zero-friction direct contact when account creation is a barrier.

errorPatterns: Role mismatch and credential errors are explicit
Chat send failures surfaced directly in panel

breakpointIntent.mobile: Single-column, thumb-friendly controls, safe-area-aware floating UI
breakpointIntent.desktop: Expanded editorial composition with richer media

mobileHardeningImplemented: Auth page collapses to focused right-panel flow
Chat overlay dimensions constrained to viewport and safe area
knownConstraints: Heavy desktop hero source remains bandwidth-intensive until fully transcoded in CI/dev environment with ffmpeg

strengths: High color contrast in core text surfaces
gapsToAddress: Add reduced-motion handling for heavy animated regions
Audit keyboard focus styles across all interactive cards/links
Run full screen-reader pass on dynamic chat/notification regions
recommendedA11yEnhancements: Prefer aria-live regions for chat status/errors
Ensure all icon-only controls have descriptive labels
Use prefers-reduced-motion media query to simplify large hero transitions

currentCharacteristics: Code splitting is used for many marketing sections
Hero media is the dominant payload contributor
Realtime features add connection overhead post-auth
existingMitigations: Scripted optimization pipeline scaffold for hero videos
Conditional rendering of chat/guest actions based on auth state
nextOptimizations: Generate and commit optimized hero files via ffmpeg in CI/local pipeline
Adopt AV1/WebM secondary source where supported
Introduce route-level skeletons for perceived loading smoothness

uiMetrics.shadowEditorial: Offset hard shadow for brand personality
uiMetrics.shadowFunctional: Soft depth for overlays and floating controls

consistencyRules: Keep CTA verbs action-first and concise
Preserve role clarity in all auth-adjacent text
Use green for positive/send/contact actions, orange for highlight/progress
Prefer one visual focal point per section
changeReviewChecklist: Does this change keep guest vs authenticated action separation clear?
Is mobile tap target size at least 40-44px?
Do motion and media choices preserve readability and performance?
Are error states visible without console dependency?
